definition: Bee — in Ghatakarpara, the bee observes honey's season and kisses the yūthikā creeper. The bee is the lover; the creeper is the beloved.

sources.claim: madhunaḥ samavekṣya kālatāṃ bhramaraś cumbati yūthikālatām

translations.note: Literal 'bee'; the image is the lover's anubhāva in miniature.
